seoTitle: Set Up Square Payments and Checkout on Squarespace
metaDescription: Learn how to connect a Square account to Squarespace for checkout, plus how to customize checkout settings, shipping, and express payment options.
intro: Connecting Square to your Squarespace store lets you accept payments securely while giving customers a smooth checkout experience. This guide covers linking your Square account through settings, testing the connection, and customizing checkout options like shipping and express payments.

steps.heading: Log into your Squarespace account
steps.body: Sign in and select the website where you want to set up checkout and payments.

steps.heading: Open Settings
steps.body: From your site dashboard, go to Settings to manage payment integrations for your store.

steps.heading: Go to Selling then Payments
steps.body: Navigate to the Selling section, then Payments, where you'll configure how your store accepts money.

steps.heading: Connect your Square account
steps.body: Select Square from the list of providers and log in with your Square business credentials to link the accounts.

steps.heading: Test your checkout
steps.body: Run a test transaction or review the payment method options on your checkout page to confirm everything works.

steps.heading: Customize checkout settings
steps.body: Set up express checkout, shipping options, or custom forms as needed to fit your store's requirements.

faq.question: How do I connect Square to Squarespace?
faq.answer: Go to Settings, then Selling, then Payments, select Square, and log in with your Square account credentials.

faq.question: Can I test my checkout after connecting Square?
faq.answer: Yes, you can run a test transaction or check the payment method options on your checkout page.

faq.question: Does this integration support shipping setup?
faq.answer: Yes, you can configure shipping options as part of setting up your Squarespace checkout.

faq.question: What are the benefits of using Square with Squarespace?
faq.answer: It gives you real-time sales tracking, easy refunds, and a POS system that keeps online and in-person sales in sync.

faq.question: Can I enable express checkout?
faq.answer: Yes, express checkout can be enabled as part of your store's payment and checkout settings.
